the PLE n-gram lookup, the elastic expert residency controller, the 256k context configuration and the
serving flags. It is applied to SGLang at `73a255206f.py --url http://127.0.0.1:30000 --prompt-tokens 101 421 1701 6821 10001 --max-tokens 128
```

`scripts/serve.sh` is the launcher that produced the published numbers; it sets the environment, launches
SGLang with the patch's flags and waits for `/health`. The published decode numbers were measured with
`--max-running-requests 1`; the launcher's default is 4 (CAMPAIGN.md:413). The full flag set is in
`assets/phase1_state.json` (`accepted.env`); the patch's flags are in `sglang/README.md`.
